test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an examination there are 150 questions and 4 marks are given for every correct answer and 1 mark is deducted for every wrong answer. A candidate attempted all 150 questions and scored 250 marks. Find the number of questions he answered correctly.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let correct = x ⇒ wrong = 150 − x

Total marks = 4x − (150 − x)

= 5x − 150

5x − 150 = 250 ⇒ x = 80

**∴ Answer = 80**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total questions = 150, +4 for correct, −1 for wrong, total score = 250

**Formula used:**

Total score = (correct × 4) − (wrong × 1)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let correct answers = x

⇒ Wrong answers = 150 − x

⇒ Score = 4x − (150 − x)

⇒ = 4x − 150 + x = 5x − 150

⇒ 5x − 150 = 250

⇒ 5x = 400

⇒ x = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Scoring System

Total score = (marks for correct) − (penalty for wrong)

Linear Equation

Form equation using total questions and score

Shortcut Insight

Each question effectively contributes +5 when switching wrong to correct
